pipeline_marker: pipeline 04-25 finished 2026-10-12 09:09:32 (final: EIA fill, baskets, CM-FDI)

headlines.source: Sector Insights summary (each sector's own source)
Clean Investment Monitor (Rhodium Group and MIT CEEPR)
EI Statistical Review of World Energy 2026

notes: Coalition: 57 economies (31 core, 26 partners); the EU-27 is one node in the Strategic network.
Trade on screen is the reconciled Comtrade matrix (importer-declared; exporters' reports x1.06 where an importer did not declare); Hong Kong is kept and tagged as a re-export hub.
Hong Kong is out of the exporter-reported Comtrade measures (RCA and the reported side of the reconciliation), as in Strategic Insights.
Critical-mineral reserves: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026.

Fossil production EI does not report separately comes from the EIA International Energy Statistics where the pipeline took it (converted to EI's units; gas and coal from EIA's latest year); where neither reports it, production is assumed to be 0 and the net balance and self-sufficiency say so (marked 'not reported separately').
Policy: IEA Policies and Measures records; Climate Action Tracker ratings where CAT rates the economy.

Cross-border clean-tech manufacturing projects: Cleantech Manufacturing FDI Dataset (CM-FDI), P. Bandara and the Net Zero Industrial Policy Lab, Johns Hopkins University, edition 2026.10.05, CC BY 4.0; project counts and sums of disclosed capital computed by the OSI authors, no record altered; undisclosed capital investment is shown as not disclosed, never zero.

Trade baskets cover Electric Vehicles, Solar, Wind, Nuclear and Semiconductors Upstream since the 2026-10 basket review; trade is also shown by sub-component (the groups of HS6 codes a basket is built from), which add up to each sector's total.
Scenario dials apply to Strategic Insights only.
